skills.name: Find common denominator and convert
skills.definition: Given two fractions with different denominators, find the least common denominator (LCD) and convert each fraction to an equivalent fraction with the LCD; also includes expressing a whole number as a fraction with a given denominator when subtracting from a mixed number or fraction.

skills.name: Subtract fractions with same denominator
skills.definition: Subtract the numerators of two fractions that have the same denominator, keeping the denominator unchanged.

skills.name: Simplify fractions
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction to its lowest terms by dividing the numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor, or recognize that it is already in simplest form.

skills.name: Decompose and recompose mixed numbers
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number into its whole number and fractional part for subtraction, and after performing fraction subtraction, combine the whole and fractional parts back into a mixed number (or integer if the fraction is zero).

skills.name: Borrow from whole number
skills.definition: When the fractional part of the minuend is smaller than the fractional part of the subtrahend, borrow 1 from the whole number part, convert it to the equivalent fraction (e.g., d/d), and add it to the fractional part before subtracting.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number with an improper fractional part (numerator ≥ denominator) into an equivalent mixed number with a proper fraction by carrying over to the whole number part.
